rationale: RackSavant works in AI alignment while Yuzhen is building AI-powered automation tools at DaBoss.ai, creating a natural complementary pairing—RackSavant's AI safety expertise could inform responsible scaling of DaBoss's business automation products. With RackSavant's Python and TypeScript skills and Yuzhen's frontend focus, they have solid technical complementarity to explore how alignment principles might strengthen accessible AI tools for non-technical users.
intro_message: RackSavant, meet Yuzhen Zhu — you're both deeply invested in AI but from different angles (alignment vs. business automation), and your technical skills could combine well to explore safer, more accessible AI tooling.
